title: Characterization of an Indicator Multi-Index
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $\alpha\colon\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\mathbb N$. The function that takes value $1$ on $S$ and $0$ off $S$ equals $\alpha$ if and only if every value of $\alpha$ is at most $1$ and $S=\{i:\alpha(i)=1\}$.
